page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.large is a general-purpose virtual machine hosted on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is powered by a dedicated 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor with x86_64 architecture, configured with 2 physical cores and 4 vCPUs via multithreading. It is equipped with 16.0 GB of RAM, establishing a 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio with 4.0 GB of memory per core. Cache resources include 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 35 MB of L3 cache. The instance includes no local storage devices, requiring attached remote network volumes, and features no GPU acceleration. Baseline network throughput is rated at 1 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate compute and memory performance within entry-level tiers. The instance achieved a Geekbench single-core score of 919.0 and a multi-core score of 2000.0. In PassMark testing, it recorded a CPU score of 3635.21 and a memory score of 1360.14, alongside a database operations result of 1105.79. Memory bandwidth measurements show uncached large-block read operations at 21.24 GB/sec and write operations at 18.69 GB/sec. Application testing demonstrates static web serving throughput of 2.44 GB/sec and Redis transaction performance of 2.86 million SET operations per second.

From an architectural efficiency standpoint, ecs.sn2.large provides balanced memory-to-vCPU capacity without incurring the overhead of local storage or specialized accelerators. It is suitable for low-to-moderate throughput workloads such as testing environments, basic internal enterprise tooling, microservices, and general web applications with minimal network traffic demands.
